newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SAirGroup unit buys European Rail Catering.
newsitem.headline: SAirGroup unit buys European Rail Catering.

text.p: SAirRelations, part of the SAirGroup, said its Rail Gourmet unit had acquired Britain's European Rail Catering, the leading supplier of food service products and logistics management to Britain's rail industry.
Terms were not disclosed. ERC, with more than 40 million sterling in annual turnover, will be integrated into Rail Gourmet, SAirRelations' own rail catering company.

"The acquisition is of great strategic importance to Rail Gourmet, more than doubling its revenue and raising its share of the European rail catering market from six to 11 percent," it said in a statement.
Rail Gourmet in March acquired Belgian-based rail catering group Restobel/Restorail.
"As a result of the acquisitions, Rail Gourmet's annual revenue is expected to increase from 33 million Swiss francs in 1996 to over 100 million for the current year," it said.

SAirRelations is one of four corporate divisions within SAirGroup and is active in the hotel, travel retail and airline and rail catering sectors. It posted 2.6 billion Swiss francs in turnover in 1996.
